title: Marvel heroes to light up Han River in Seoul’s final drone show of year
caption:
Seoul is ending its drone light show season with a record-breaking 2,000-drone Marvel performance. The show features Iron Man and iconic cinematic scenes synchronized to music above the Han River.

Source: Koreaherald - Marvel heroes to light up Han River in Seoul’s final drone show of year
